challenge.method: Tested the null-input delegation, the invalid old pointers and zero-size conditions, and a successful replacement whose pointer representation may equal the old pointer value.
challenge.results: The failure clause applies to a valid non-null pointer, nonzero size and failure to allocate the new object. The successful replacement rule can return the same pointer value and remains outside this preservation claim.

limitations: This concerns allocation failure for an otherwise applicable call. Successful replacement, size-zero handling, and external errno or allocator behavior have separate scopes.
Scope is the exact N3220 C2y working draft. Published ISO text and observed implementation behavior require separate evidence.
